definitions.explanation: A document to be filled out when applying for something.

examples.japanese: {申込書|もうしこみしょ}に{記入|きにゅう}してください。
examples.english: Please fill out the application form.

examples.japanese: {申込書|もうしこみしょ}を{提出|ていしゅつ}した。
{申込書|もうしこみしょ}はどこでもらえますか。
examples.english: Where can I get an application form?

notes:
COMPOUND: {申|もう}し{込|こ}み (application) + {書|しょ} (document)

Note: Also written as {申|もう}し{込|こ}み{用紙|ようし} (application form/paper).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {申込書|もうしこみしょ}に{記入|きにゅう}する (fill out an application form)
- {申込書|もうしこみしょ}を{提出|ていしゅつ}する (submit an application form)
- {申込書|もうしこみしょ}をダウンロードする (download an application form)

SIMILAR DOCUMENT NAMES:
- {履歴書|りれきしょ} (resume)
- {申請書|しんせいしょ} (official application/petition)
- {入会|にゅうかい}{申込書|もうしこみしょ} (membership application form)
